description: This Dart source file defines the `AttendanceProvider` class, which manages the state and logic related to attendance tracking in a Flutter application. It handles actions such as marking attendance, loading daily and weekly reports, auto-refreshing data periodically, and synchronizing offline data with the backend.

classes.name: AttendanceProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing attendance state, integrating with an AttendanceRepository to perform backend communications, providing public methods for marking attendance, fetching reports, auto-refreshing, and offline sync.

methods.name: markNow
methods.description: Marks the current attendance status (present or absent), then refreshes daily and weekly data if successful.

methods.name: loadDaily
methods.description: Loads attendance data for a specific date.

methods.name: loadWeekly
methods.description: Loads attendance data starting from a specific week start date.

methods.name: startAutoRefresh
methods.description: Begins periodic refresh of attendance data and syncs offline data at specified intervals.

methods.name: syncPending
methods.description: Attempts to sync offline stored attendance data with the backend.
